name: Morimura Tenma
source:
One of the Hachiyou, he is the Seiryuu of Earth. Tenma is Akane's classmate and friend, who is pulled into Kyou with her. He has little concern for formality and can be abrasive, but he has a strong sense of responsibility to others. Tenma's younger sister has been missing for some time. His elemental attribute is Thunder, and his dragon jewel is located on his left arm.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de]Wikipedia[/url]]
